class Rectangle(width: Int, height: Int) {
  def area(): Int = {
    if (width > 0 && height > 0) {
      width * height
    } else {
      0
    }
  }

  def classify(score: Int): Int =
    if (score > 90) 3 else if (score > 50) 2 else 1

  def pick(a: Int, b: Int, c: Int): Int = {
    a match {
      case 1 => b
      case 2 => c
      case _ => a
    }
  }

  def loop(n: Int): Int = {
    var total = 0
    for (i <- 0 until n) {
      if (i % 2 == 0 || i % 3 == 0) {
        total += i
      }
    }
    while (total > 100 && n > 0) {
      total -= n
    }
    total
  }
}
